Process, Tolerances & Applications Key Takeaways CNC precision machining focuses on controlling part variation within strict dimensional requirements rather than simply producing smaller features. Many precision machining applications can achieve tolerances around ±0.025 mm when the part design and manufacturing conditions are suitable. The final accuracy of a machined part depends on how well the process is planned, controlled, and verified from design to inspection.
